summary: Injuries reshape the Week 5 backfields: Barkley, Monangai, Achane and Etienne are out, Lamar Jackson sits for Baltimore, Chicago starts Tyson Bagent at QB, and Arizona is expected to sit Marvin Harrison Jr. amid trade talk.

NFL|00-0038542|car.note: Atlanta has gone run-first since Penix took over, and as a home favorite facing backup QB Huntley the script favors a heavy Bijan workload; Brian Robinson's roughly 35% snap share is the cap.

detail.matchup: Denver is missing both starting corners, Surtain and Moss, and its pass rush gets a line that finished last week with four rookies; Herbert has been sacked 12 times, tied for second most.
detail.script: As 3.5-point home underdogs averaging 16.8 points, the Chargers project to throw from behind, raising scramble chances.
detail.conditions: Indoor game at SoFi.
detail.experts: Previews focus on Herbert facing heavy pressure and the offense needing to adapt its plan around the line.

CFB-week.summary: The only game in the window is Delaware at Middle Tennessee on Tuesday night, a Conference USA matchup of two 2-3 teams with Middle Tennessee a short home favorite (about 1.5) and a total near 48.5. As of Sunday no reputable book or odds page had posted player props; Covers and SportsGrid both list none, so there are no lines to screen this week.

NFL-BAL-at-ATL-1012.summary: Lamar Jackson (ankle) and Trey Hendrickson are out, so Tyler Huntley starts and Atlanta is about a 3-3.5-point home favorite with a 43.5 total. Zay Flowers (foot, never full in practice) is expected to play per Schefter. Atlanta's offense has turned run-first under Penix (Bijan 194 and 145 rush yards the last two weeks, five team rushing TDs vs New Orleans), and its run defense has allowed just two rushing TDs, which caps Derrick Henry.

NFL-BUF-at-LA-1013.summary: Monday night shootout setup (total 54.5) with the Rams now 3.5-point home favorites, up from 2.5 midweek, as Buffalo deals with WR DJ Moore (shoulder, DNP Thu/Fri, questionable), WR Joshua Palmer out and DT Ed Oliver out. Kyren Williams is a near every-down back for LA (70 snaps, 13 targets in Week 4) while Corum has faded, and Keon Coleman is Buffalo's main beneficiary if Moore sits.

NFL-CHI-at-GB-1011.summary: Tyson Bagent makes his second straight start for Chicago (Caleb Williams, hamstring, only returned to limited practice Friday), so the packet's QB listing is out of date. Kyle Monangai (toe) is out after 30 carries and 2 TDs last week, leaving D'Andre Swift (full Friday, no designation) as the lead back for the league's top rushing offense against a Packers run defense allowing about 139 rush yards per game. Green Bay is thin on the interior OL (Banks, Monk doubtful) and without LB Edgerrin Cooper and Micah Parsons; winds around 12-13 mph, gusting near 20.

NFL-CIN-at-MIA-1011.summary: Chase (concussion) and Higgins (groin/adductor) are questionable but both practiced fully Friday, and Saturday's practice-squad call-up was a safety rather than a receiver, so both are trending toward playing; the total reportedly fell from 48.5 to about 42.5 on the receiver news. Miami is 0-4, has the league's lowest-volume offense (Willis 9-of-17 last week, 52.5 plays per game), is missing CB Reese Taylor and TE Justin Joly, and lost De'Von Achane for the season to a torn ACL.

NFL-CLE-at-NYJ-1011.summary: Cleveland (3-1, coming off a 27-24 Thursday-night win, so on extra rest) visits a banged-up Jets team missing RB Breece Hall, WR Adonai Mitchell, LG Dylan Parham and LB Kiko Mauigoa. Braelon Allen took every Jets carry last week. Cleveland is missing both starting DTs (Mason Graham, Mike Hall Jr.), TE Carsen Ryan and WR Tylan Wallace. The total is low (39.5-40, Jets -1.5 to -2.5) and the packet forecast calls for heavy rain and gusty wind, which I could not confirm independently.

NFL-DET-at-ARI-1011.summary: This sets up as a dome shootout (total 54.5): Detroit's offense ranks 6th in EPA, but its defense is last in opponent EPA and is missing S Brian Branch and CB Rock Ya-Sin. Arizona has allowed 30+ points in three straight games. Arizona is reportedly deactivating Marvin Harrison Jr. ahead of a pending trade, which concentrates Brissett's targets on McBride and Michael Wilson. Detroit's interior line is thinned (C Cade Mays and G Ben Bartch out), and the line has moved from DET -4.5 to -5.5.

NFL-HOU-at-TEN-1011.summary: A low-total divisional game (about 37.5-38.5, down from 39.5 early in the week) with Houston a 6.5-7 point road favorite despite an 0-4 ATS start, and Tennessee scoring under 14 points per game. Houston's backfield has shifted to a drive-by-drive Montgomery/Marks rotation, with Marks taking goal-line carries the last two weeks; three Texans offensive linemen are questionable with illness.

NFL-IND-at-PIT-1011.summary: Heavy rain from hurricane remnants is forecast around kickoff, and the total has dropped from 47.5 at open to about 43.5, which points to a run-leaning, lower-scoring game. Pittsburgh is without WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, out, multi-week) and CB Jamel Dean, Ramsey is questionable, and RB Rico Dowdle (toe) is questionable after practicing limited all week, so Jaylen Warren's bellcow role is at risk. Indianapolis is thin at WR (Slayton and Dulin out, Allen questionable after a full Friday practice) and comes off a London trip, while Pittsburgh has 10 days of rest.

NFL-MIN-at-NO-1011.summary: Unbeaten, defense-first Minnesota (NFL-low 12.8 ppg allowed, league-high 16 sacks, blitz-heavy Flores scheme) visits a 1-3 Saints team on a short week after a Monday-night loss. The Vikings offense is shaky (Murray back from a concussion, LT Darrisaw out, LG Jackson lost for the season, RT O'Neill questionable, Jefferson and Addison questionable after limited weeks) and has leaned on Reichard field goals. The Saints are pass-heavy by necessity (Shough leads the NFL in attempts) with Etienne on IR and Kamara questionable with a back injury; current DraftKings line is MIN -1.5, total 42.5.

NFL-PHI-at-JAX-1011.summary: Philadelphia arrives in London gutted: Barkley, DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown and C Drew Kendall are out (Greenard reported out by NBCSP), Lane Johnson retired and Jurgens was traded, so two undrafted rookies start on the interior line with third-string RB Will Shipley as lead back. Jacksonville moved from a short underdog to a 7.5-point favorite, pointing to a Jaguars-lead, Tuten-heavy, conservative script and a pass-heavy, low-efficiency Eagles offense.

NFL-SF-at-SEA-1011.summary: Undefeated San Francisco plays a run-first offense (35 rushes vs Denver) and visits a Seattle defense that leads the NFL in yards and passing yards allowed, while missing Nick Bosa, S Marques Sigle, FB Kyle Juszczyk and possibly nickel CB Upton Stout (DNP Friday). Emanuel Wilson is Seattle's clear lead back, with Charbonnet on PUP, rookie Jadarian Price on IR and Holani limited. Mike Evans played through a rib injury and sat out Thursday's practice. The total has slipped from 46.5 to 45.5, with Seattle -3.

NFL-DEN-at-LAC-1011.summary: The 0-4 Chargers are home underdogs (+3.5) with both starting tackles (Slater, Alt) and G Penning out, leaving a line that finished last week with four rookies; Herbert has taken 12 sacks. Denver is without both starting corners (Surtain, Moss), and 24 of 31 national picks back the Broncos, pointing to a low-scoring game where the Chargers' run game is the most fragile volume.

best.why: With Saquon Barkley ruled out and Tank Bigsby on injured reserve, Will Shipley starts for Philadelphia in London, and books price his rushing yards near 37, which implies lead-back volume. The app's carries average comes from his old backup role. The risk is a trailing script and some rotation with the newly promoted Dameon Pierce.
